introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Course Craft ("we," "us," or "our") values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and share your data when you use our website and services.

informationWeCollect.title: 1. Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.intro: We collect the following types of information when you use Course Craft:

items.accountInfo: Account Information: When you register for an account, we collect your name, email address, and other details necessary for account management.
items.uploadedContent: Uploaded Content: We collect any files or content you upload, including PDFs and any chat history generated during your interactions with the Gemini AI agent.
items.usageData: Usage Data: We collect information about how you interact with Course Craft, such as pages visited, features used, and timestamps.

howWeUse.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.intro: We use the collected information to:
items: Communicate with you about your account or any updates to our services.
Personalize your experience with Course Craft.
Process payments and manage billing (if applicable).
Comply with legal obligations and resolve disputes.

dataStorage.title: 3. Data Storage and Security
dataStorage.content: Your information is stored on secure servers. We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data, but please note that no data transmission over the internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.

sharing.title: 4. Sharing Your Information
sharing.intro: We do not share your personal information with third parties except in the following cases:

items.serviceProviders: Service Providers: We may share your data with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating the Services, such as hosting providers and payment processors.
items.legalRequirements: Legal Requirements: We may disclose your information if required by law or in response to legal processes such as subpoenas or court orders.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience on Course Craft. Cookies help us remember your preferences, analyze usage patterns, and improve our Services. You can control cookie settings through your browser settings.

dataRetention.title: 6. Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain your information for as long as necessary to provide the Services and comply with legal obligations. If you wish to delete your account or any personal information, please contact us at {email}.

yourRights.title: 7. Your Rights
yourRights.content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to access, update, or delete your personal data. You may also have the right to object to certain processing activities or withdraw consent where applicable.

internationalTransfers.title: 8. International Transfers
internationalTransfers.content: Your information may be transferred to and stored on servers located outside your country of residence. By using the Services, you consent to this transfer.

childrenPrivacy.title: 9. Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.content: Course Craft is not intended for use by children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect or solicit personal information from anyone under 13 years of age. If we learn that we have inadvertently collected such information, we will take steps to delete it.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make significant changes, we will post the updated policy on this page and update the effective date. Please review this policy periodically for any updates.

contact.title: 11. Contact Us
contact.intro: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact us at:

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.description: Welcome to Course Craft! Follow these simple steps to create your first course:
gettingStarted.step1: Sign in with your Google account to access the platform
gettingStarted.step2: Click 'Create New Course' on your dashboard to start a new project
gettingStarted.step3: Upload your course materials (PDF files) - up to 10 files per course
gettingStarted.step4: Follow the guided workflow to generate and refine your course outline, then design your website

uploadingFiles.title: Uploading Course Materials
uploadingFiles.description: Upload your course materials to help our AI understand your content and generate a comprehensive outline:
uploadingFiles.tip1: Only PDF files are currently supported
uploadingFiles.tip2: You can upload up to 10 PDF files per course, and the total size of all files cannot exceed 32MB
uploadingFiles.tip3: Drag and drop files directly onto the upload area, or click 'Browse files' to select from your computer
uploadingFiles.tip4: Make sure your PDFs contain clear, readable text for best results

creatingOutline.title: Creating Your Course Outline
creatingOutline.description: After uploading your materials, our AI will generate an initial course outline. You can refine it through conversation:
creatingOutline.tip1: Use the chat interface to request changes, add modules, or modify content
creatingOutline.tip2: Ask for more detail on specific topics or request different learning approaches
creatingOutline.tip3: Edit the course title directly by clicking on it
creatingOutline.tip4: View different versions of your outline and compare changes
creatingOutline.note: The outline will update in real-time as you chat with the AI assistant. You can expand or collapse modules to focus on specific sections.

designingWebsite.title: Designing Your Course Website
designingWebsite.description: Once your outline is ready, transform it into a beautiful, interactive course website:
designingWebsite.tip1: Use the chat interface to customize the layout, colors, and styling of your website
designingWebsite.tip2: Request specific design elements like headers, sections, or interactive components
designingWebsite.tip3: Preview your website in real-time as you make changes
designingWebsite.tip4: Open the full-page preview in a new tab to see how it will look to your students
designingWebsite.preview: The web preview updates automatically as you modify the design. You can swap the chat and preview panels for a better view.

q1.question: What file formats are supported?
q1.answer: Currently, Course Craft only supports PDF files. Make sure your course materials are saved as PDFs before uploading.

q2.question: How many files can I upload?
q2.answer: You can upload up to 10 PDF files per course. This limit helps ensure optimal processing and outline generation.

q3.question: Can I edit my course after creating it?
q3.answer: Yes! You can always return to your course from the dashboard to modify the outline or redesign the website. However, note that certain changes may require regenerating parts of your course.

q4.question: How does the AI assistant work?
q4.answer: Our AI assistant uses advanced language models to understand your course materials and generate outlines. You can chat with it naturally to refine and customize your course structure and website design.

q5.question: Is my data secure?
q5.answer: Yes, we take data security seriously. Your uploaded files and course content are stored securely and are only accessible to you. Please review our Privacy Policy for more details.

issue1.title: Files won't upload
issue1.solution: Make sure you're uploading PDF files only. Check that your files aren't corrupted and try refreshing the page. If the problem persists, try uploading fewer files at once.

issue2.title: AI responses are slow or not appearing
issue2.solution: AI processing can take some time, especially for complex requests. Wait a moment and check your internet connection. If responses don't appear after several minutes, try refreshing the page or rephrasing your request.

issue3.title: Course outline or website preview not loading
issue3.solution: Try refreshing the page. If the issue continues, check that you have a stable internet connection. You can also try navigating back to the dashboard and reopening your course.

contact.title: Need More Help?
contact.description: If you can't find the answer you're looking for, please review our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy pages, or contact our support team for assistance.
